content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_covenant_bitwise_not_integer.rs::covenant_admits_integer_bitwise_not_in_its_fragment demonstrates the divergence. Authority: .design/syntax/ast.md REQ-10/OQ-4 (integer ! is bitwise-not, Verus-native, certifies under Verus type-directed !). covenant_eval.rs eval_expr's UnaryOp::Not arm only handles Value::Bool(!v.as_bool()?); an integer operand errors Type, which analyze_covenant maps to CovenantUnsupportedItem -> L0 refusal before burn. Same item without a witness block certifies L3. Fix: extend the Not arm to bitwise-not on Value::Int under the i128 model (truncation is the documented agreement model).
